features.feature: very wide flat hull (two pressure hulls under one casing), anechoic tiles with renewed and fallen tiles
20 missile tubes in two rows forward of the sail under hinged doors (breakable rows)
long low sail aft of the silo: rounded top, bridge windows, masts, ladders, the SAM post
cruciform stern with end-plated planes, towed-array pod, twin shrouded screws (breakable)
retractable bow planes, limber holes along the casing, waterline band
deck gun on the forecasing (single barrel; mb_fix_barrels makes the pair)
surfaced fittings: stanchions and lifelines, bollards, rescue buoys, vents, life rings
